title: checkpointGraph
responsibility: Evaluate checkpoint eligibility from one tick snapshot and apply eligible actions in stable order.

inputs.name: conditionMatches.condition
inputs.description: State field, comparison operator and expected value defining one checkpoint condition.

inputs.name: conditionMatches.state
inputs.description: Read-only game state evaluated without modifying the supplied snapshot.

inputs.name: checkpointEligible.node
inputs.description: Checkpoint whose completion status, prerequisites and conditions determine eligibility.

inputs.name: checkpointEligible.run
inputs.description: Current deterministic tick, game state, completed checkpoints, events and execution trace.

inputs.name: checkpointGraph.run
inputs.description: Current deterministic tick, game state, completed checkpoints, events and execution trace.

inputs.name: checkpointGraph.view
inputs.description: Active game view containing scene direction and executable checkpoints.

outputs.name: conditionMatches
outputs.description: Whether the current field satisfies equality or the supported numeric comparison.

outputs.name: checkpointEligible
outputs.description: Whether the checkpoint can run given prior completion, prerequisites and current state.

outputs.name: checkpointGraph
outputs.description: New game run with eligible checkpoint actions, bounded trace and emitted events applied once in stable order.
